title: Teachers' Protests, 2022–2023
grammar: Recap: attributing a judgement with szerint
goal: I can describe the teachers' protests and strikes of 2022–2023, with dates (*pedagógus, szakszervezet, sztrájk, elégséges szolgáltatás*).

sections.title: Unit 36: Civil Society and Local Communities, 2010–2026
body: Between 2019 and 2026 teachers, local governments, local residents and civil society organisations were at the centre of several public disputes in Hungary: about strike rules in schools, about the finances of towns, about large battery factories and about the country's relationship with the European Union. In each dispute the government and its critics gave different accounts, and both are reported here with their sources.

In five short accounts you follow these events year by year, name who judged them how, and practise the forms a neutral history needs: attribution, cause and result, proportion, contrast and concession. The period ends with the parliamentary election of 12 April 2026.
